features: Dual Mode ONU Technology: Supports both GPON and GEPON modes with 802.11ac wireless standard for high-speed connectivity
Full Compatibility: Compatible with IEEE802.3ah and ITU-T G.984.x standards ensuring seamless integration with existing network infrastructure
Easy Installation and Management: Features plug and play functionality with auto-detecting, auto-configuration, and auto firmware upgrade capabilities
Advanced Network Control: Supports port-based rate limitation and loop detection for enhanced network security and performance
Remote Configuration: Integrated OAM and OMCI remote configuration and maintenance function for convenient network management
Extended Transmission Range: Supports up to 20KM transmission distance for long-range fiber optic connectivity
Layer 3 Features: Supports dual stack IPv4 and IPv6 protocols with multiple SSID support for flexible network configuration
Security and Network Functions: Includes NAT and firewall functionality to protect your network from unauthorized access
Integrated Diagnostics: Built-in line test feature for troubleshooting and maintaining optimal network performance
description: The ONT is based on high-performance chip, supports XPON dual-mode technology (EPON and GPON), and also supports Layer 2/Layer 3 functions, providing data service for carrier-grade FTTH applications.
